art_direction: 珍珠雾蓝 · 偷偷看你: 珍珠白底，雾蓝侧视猫眼，细短嘴与轻盈眉点。
composition_variation: A flat pearl-white field with the faintest cool gray undertone. Misty glacier-blue irises and velvety black pupils. Graceful long almond eyes, upper lids lowered softly, pupils glancing a little toward the right as though noticing a friend. Coordinate both eyes into a pleasing slight three-quarter perspective; only a subtle difference in width. Tapered flowing upper lids rather than thick horizontal blocks. One tiny white reflected stroke in each eye. Two miniature cool-gray eyebrow dabs, and a very small flat mouth beneath the gap. Refined, pretty, quietly playful; clean large negative space.
